scheme_name: Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
description:
The Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme was launched by the Government of Jharkhand in the year 2016. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students who are pursuing their education at the pre-matriculation level. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to reduce dropout rates among Scheduled Caste students by providing them with necessary financial support. 

The scheme specifically targets students studying in classes 9 and 10. 

The government has set a measurable target to ensure that at least 50,000 Scheduled Caste students benefit from this scholarship annually. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to cover various educational expenses. 

Eligible students receive a scholarship amount of INR 1,000 per annum for students in class 9. 

For students in class 10, the scholarship amount is increased to INR 1,500 per annum. 

This financial support is aimed at alleviating the economic burden on families and encouraging students to continue their education. 

To be eligible for the Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme, students must belong to the Scheduled Caste category as defined by the Government of India. 

Students must be residents of Jharkhand and must have completed their previous class with a minimum of 50 percent marks. 

The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed INR 2.5 lakh. 

Students must be enrolled in a recognized school in Jharkhand to qualify for the scholarship. 

The application process for the scholarship is conducted online through the official website of the Jharkhand Government. 

Students need to visit the official scholarship portal and register themselves. 

They must fill out the application form with accurate personal and educational details. 

Required documents include a caste certificate issued by a competent authority. 

Students must also provide their previous academic marksheet as proof of eligibility. 

A copy of the bank passbook is required to facilitate the disbursement of the scholarship amount. 

Additionally, students must submit an income certificate to verify their family's annual income. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The scholarship amount is disbursed directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

The disbursement of the scholarship is typically done on an annual basis. 

The government aims to complete the disbursement process by the end of the academic year, usually by March of each year. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Minorities, and Backward Classes in Jharkhand. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and ensuring that the funds are allocated appropriately. 

For any queries or assistance related to the scholarship, students can contact the department through their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is available on the official website of the Jharkhand Government. 

The scheme has seen a significant increase in the number of beneficiaries since its inception. 

In the first year of implementation, approximately 30,000 students received the scholarship. 

By the year 2021, this number had increased to over 50,000 beneficiaries. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 50 crore for the financial year 2023-2024 for this scheme. 

This allocation reflects the commitment of the Jharkhand Government to support the education of Scheduled Caste students. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote education among marginalized communities in the state. 

The Jharkhand government has also initiated awareness programs to inform eligible students about the scholarship. 

These programs are conducted in collaboration with local schools and educational institutions. 

The government encourages schools to actively participate in the dissemination of information regarding the scholarship. 

Feedback from beneficiaries indicates a positive impact on their educational pursuits due to the financial assistance provided. 

Many students have reported that the scholarship has helped them purchase books and other educational materials. 

The scheme has also contributed to increased enrollment rates among Scheduled Caste students in higher secondary education. 

The Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme is a crucial step towards achieving educational equity. 

It aims to empower Scheduled Caste students by providing them with the financial means to pursue their studies. 

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the impact of the scholarship on student retention rates. 

The scheme aligns with the national objectives of promoting education among disadvantaged groups. 

It reflects the government's commitment to social justice and educational inclusivity. 

The scholarship is renewable each year, provided students maintain the required academic performance. 

Students are encouraged to apply for the scholarship every year to continue receiving financial support. 

The Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme is a vital resource for many families in the state. 

It plays a significant role in breaking the cycle of poverty through education. 

The scheme has become a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

Overall, the Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme represents a proactive approach to enhancing educational opportunities for Scheduled Caste students. 

It is an essential component of the state's efforts to promote social equity and uplift marginalized communities. 

The ongoing success of this scheme depends on continued government support and effective implementation. 

The scheme is a testament to the importance of education as a tool for empowerment and development. 

In conclusion, the Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme is a comprehensive initiative aimed at fostering educational attainment among Scheduled Caste students in Jharkhand. 

It provides essential financial assistance and support to ensure that these students can pursue their academic goals without financial hindrance.
